name: TeamStarWolf - HTB Linux Techniques (precise)
description: Curated practitioner view, not an official MITRE mapping. Precise-pattern frequency of 19 core techniques across the 347 content-verified Linux Hack The Box walkthroughs (of 529 total). Keyword/tag-derived from walkthrough text; treat as lower-bound evidence. Scores normalize to the maximum (323 machines) within the Linux subset, not to sample size; 100 is not 100% prevalence. Technique IDs and tactic slugs are ATT&CK v19.2. Provenance: 529-machine uniform mine, 2026-09-26.
